Title: Custom reports for Verizon Standard and Premium profiles

Body.Content: You can now find custom reports in the supplemental management portal for both Verizon profile types. Access this feature by selecting the Manage button at the top of the blade for your Verizon profile, and then going to Analytics > Custom Reports in the supplemental management portal.
